content:
sam: Quick thought — re: runtime routing oscillation when multiple regions have near-equal cost/latency. Idea: add a small entropy penalty + backpressure shim so route scores get a tiny deterministic decay proportional to recent selection frequency.

anya: how tiny? can we avoid non-determinism for reproducible debugging?

sam: Proposal: deterministic entropy via tenant-seed + time-bucket (no pure RNG). Penalty = alpha * selection_count_decay where selection_count_decay uses exp decay (half-life ~300s).

mike: how does this interact with SLA tiers? high-tier customers shouldn't get penalized into worse region.

sam: We make the penalty tunable by tier. Policy-level multiplier: tier_multipliers so enterprise can set 0.0. Default e.g., 0.05 for free/trial.

lee: sketch of policy DSL snippet: 

```
policy {
  matcher: region_preference
  penalty {
    entropy_seed: tenant_id
    decay_half_life: "300s"
    base_alpha: 0.02
    tier_multipliers: { "standard": 0.02, "enterprise": 0.0 }
  }
}
```

anya: telemetry: we need counters 'entropy_penalty_applied' and histogram of score deltas. Also record per-tenant fallback counts.

mike: runtime backpressure idea: when a shard's gpu_util or p99 spikes, temporarily bump penalty for routes using that shard so traffic flows elsewhere.

sam: runtime will expose 'load_metrics' and a probe loop computes backpressure factor bp = clamp((util - threshold)/scale, 0, 1). Final penalty = base_alpha * (1 + bp * bp_weight).

ops-bot: deploy:policy-service v3.12.0 started canary to partition 17

anya: Ops note: include at least one high-tier tenant in canary to validate tier-multiplier path.

lee: Concern: per-tenant selection_count state could be huge. Tracking route+tenant cardinality might blow memory.

sam: Implementation plan: only track top-k active tenants per route via LRU (k=10k default), fall back to global decayed counter for infrequent tenants. Also cap entries per-route.

mike: avoid RPCs on hot path. Compute penalty at policy-eval using cached counters. Counter updates via async aggregator pushed every 30s.

anya: rollout plan + kill-switch: 1) internal canary (10 hosts), 2) 5% prod, 3) 25% prod, 4) GA. Automated rollback thresholds: increase in regional p95 > 5% OR tenant error spike.

sam: metrics to watch: regional p95 latency, route churn (routes/sec change), tenant error rate, cost-per-token.

lee: explainability: decision logs must include trace fields like 'entropy_penalty=0.003' so engineers can see contribution.

mike: ACK. I'll prototype a policy adapter and a simulator harness to run synthetic oscillation tests.

sam: Action items: mike prototype + sim (ETA 1w); anya telemetry & dashboards (ETA 3d); lee ops plan for LRU & memory cap (ETA 2d); sam to draft RFC with estimator math.

ops-bot: deploy:policy-service v3.12.0 canary finished 14m, status: healthy :thumbsup:

anya: quick follow-up — record canary tenant IDs in thread for postmortem.

sam: adding them to the RFC draft.

lee: ensure feature-flag toggle so SRE can disable per-tenant tracking quickly.

mike: one open question: additive vs multiplicative with existing penalties? I vote additive on score (penalty adds positive value).

sam: agreed additive preserves monotonic invariants and is easier to reason about.

anya: catching up in 30m sync to review the RFC.

mike: :rocket:
